after.zh: 一整条光谱，被三种感光元件压成三个数，这就是相机（和人眼）看到的颜色。
after.en: A whole spectrum, squeezed by three kinds of sensor into three numbers: that is the colour a camera (and an eye) sees.

t.zh: 彩色照片每个像素有三个数：R、G、B。可现实里的光不止三种，而是像彩虹那样一整条，从紫到红连成一片，叫光谱。
t.en: Each pixel of a colour photo has three numbers: R, G and B. But real light is not three kinds; it is a whole band like a rainbow, from violet to red, called a spectrum.

t.zh: 相机和人眼一样，只有三种感光元件，各自对一段波长敏感。每种元件对每个波长有多敏感，画出来是一条灵敏度曲线。
t.en: A camera, like the human eye, has only three kinds of sensor, each sensitive to a range of wavelengths. How sensitive each is at each wavelength, drawn out, is its sensitivity curve.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：日光的光谱和三条灵敏度曲线
caption.en: Set 1: the daylight spectrum and the three sensitivity curves

t.zh: 这一关的输入都是波形：一条光谱和三条灵敏度曲线，每条 10 个点，从紫到红。<part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>把一行数平均成一个数。
t.en: This level's inputs are all waveforms: a spectrum and three sensitivity curves, 10 points each, from violet to red. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> turns a row of numbers into one number.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：算出相机读到的 R、G、B 三个数，分别接到输出的 R、G、B 口，看它们组成的彩色像素。 没接的颜色通道按 0 处理；直接接「图」口则输出整张图。
t.en: Calculate the R, G and B readings and connect them to the matching output ports to see the resulting colour pixel. Unconnected colour channels are zero; connect the Image port to output a whole image directly.

brief.zh: 「光谱」是从紫（400 nm）到红（700 nm）的 10 个波段各有多少光。相机有三种感光元件，各有一条灵敏度曲线。每种的读数 = 光谱乘上它的灵敏度曲线，再求平均。将三个读数接入输出的 R、G、B 口。
brief.en: The "Spectrum" is how much light there is in each of 10 bands from violet (400 nm) to red (700 nm). The camera has three kinds of sensor, each with a sensitivity curve. Each sensor reads the spectrum times its sensitivity curve, averaged. Connect the three readings to the R, G and B output ports.
